title: A fresh remark leaves familiar words

captions.physics: Leaving feelings within an uncertain wish
captions.energy: Beginning a response without prepared wording

meaning: You can leave feelings within an uncertain wish and begin a response without prepared wording, experiencing farewell to familiar words without immediately finding an equally convenient replacement.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Moon in the physical position can appear in an uncertain wish instead of an understandable response. The Fool in energy supports wanting to begin without prepared wording or knowing the form in advance. Death in emotions brings farewell to familiar words. You can try a living remark and miss the ease of a known expression. Losing the formula concerns speech rather than determining closeness’s future.

Suppose a general “May everything work out as it should” leaves what is actually wished unclear. Something specific emerges in conversation: “I would like you to be able to tell that story calmly”. **A living response need not repeat a familiar formula**. The answer gains personal substance without having to sound unusual. Yet a simple familiar wish disappears, and the new remark may feel awkward. This does not prove earlier warmth empty; another way of naming an actual wish has emerged instead of a general hint.

Difficulty arises if the fresh reply is immediately replaced by the old general phrase to recover convenience quickly. A new possibility receives no room because first words feel awkward. The constructive Fool helps leave the beginning open without instant ease. You can miss an accustomed expression and continue differently; farewell requires neither forever banning earlier words nor finding a perfect replacement equally suitable for every future approach.
